caption: The drawing depicts a single standing figure, centrally placed against a blank, light-colored background. The figure is dressed in a long robe with a blueish-gray upper garment and reddish-brown lower portion, which extends to the ankles, and is tied at the waist with a similarly colored sash. The figure wears a dark cap on its head and has light brown skin. Both hands are holding a rectangular, tan-colored tablet or board, which has a thin greenish border. The base of the figure appears round and green, suggesting it is on a pedestal or stand. The overall composition is vertically oriented with the figure occupying the central portion of the drawing, leaving ample empty space around it.
title: Tea Store Figure
